tinyhar.architecture: Original TinyHAR_Model; transformer/FC/LSTM/tnaive configuration, 20 shared filters. Adapter inserts one dimension only.
tinyhar.training: Paper Adam 1e-4, batch 256, max 150 epochs. Shared harness uses Macro-F1 early stopping (patience 15). Repository Train_baseline.py instead sets 1e-3 for its DeepConvLSTM experiment; not silently treated as TinyHAR paper setting.
differences: Released convolutions alternate strides 1,2,1,2, unlike the paper prose suggesting stride 2 throughout. Released code is retained.
Original data splits, normalization, sampling frequency and window sizes are replaced by the user-requested AutoResearcHAR protocol.

tinierhar.architecture: Original TinierHAR_Model and configs/model.yaml: 2 pooling blocks + 4 additional residual blocks, 4 initial filters, bidirectional GRU with 16 units per direction, dropout .3.
tinierhar.training: train.py: Adam .001, batch 32, 80 epochs; validation-loss plateau LR factor .1 / patience 7; early-stop patience 15. LR schedule is replayed from source-validation training during final train+val refit.
differences: Checkpoint/early-stop objective remains source-validation Macro-F1, rather than author validation loss.
Original source model constructor updates BN statistics during its dummy shape pass; retained unchanged.

bilstmattention.architecture: PyTorch port of the pinned author architecture; see research/modules/architectures/torch_author.py and bilstmattention.py.
bilstmattention.training: Published preset hyperparameters with PyTorch optimizers and source-validation checkpoint selection.
differences: PyTorch execution, initialization RNG, dropout RNG and optimizer implementation replace TensorFlow. Numerical forward/gradient parity is tested after transferring author weights; this does not establish benchmark reproduction.
Source-only evaluation, fixed ontology and resampling follow the project protocol.

deepconvlstmattention.architecture: Original TECO benchmark DeepConvLSTM_ATTN; no claim that TECO is the original attention paper author.
deepconvlstmattention.training: Adam .001, batch64, max150/patience15 are shared-harness choices, not a verified original attention-paper recipe.
differences: Auxiliary search alternative, not one of the supplied paper five LOSO baselines.

deepconvlstm.architecture: Four valid5x1/64-filter convolutions, two128-unit peephole LSTMs, last-time-step classifier; cell/gate equations from Lasagne recurrent.py revision5d3c63cb315c50b1cbd27a6bc8664b406f34dd99.
deepconvlstm.training: Paper batch100, RMSProp rho.9, learning rate literally printed 10e-3 (=.01), orthogonal matrix initialization and .5 dropout on dense-layer inputs. Lasagne epsilon1e-6 inside sqrt. Max300 epochs is an explicit reconstruction assumption.
differences: Original Theano/Lasagne runtime unavailable in modern environment; recurrence port checked independently against NumPy equations.
Inference notebook omits dropout; paper training dropout is applied before final dense layer.
Exact original training script/seed and framework version not released. Per-gate orthogonal initialization and normal(.1) peephole initialization explicitly combine paper and Lasagne defaults.
No claim of bit-identical optimizer/kernel results or pretrained-checkpoint compatibility.

spectra.architecture: Hann-windowed STFT magnitude; depthwise+pointwise Conv2d with BN/ReLU/residual; CxC QKV attention with gamma; temporal projection; BiGRU; attention pooling; dropout/classifier.

assumptions.reshape: Paper conv output LxFxD does not specify how to recover CxD sensor tokens. Retain C mixed feature maps, then project frequency bins to D features for each channel.

spectra.training: Paper gives2s windows/50% overlap/50Hz/standardization/cross-entropy. Adam .001, batch64, 150 epochs/patience15 are explicit assumptions; original optimizer/settings are unspecified.
differences: No author code was found. User authorized paper reconstruction.
Parameter count and reported F1 cannot be asserted identical because key dimensions/reshape are unspecified.
